neighbours.label: ' question' in the idiom 'that's the (million-dollar / big) question' meaning the key unknown
fire: Can the startup turn a profit before the money runs out? That's the billion-dollar question.
Will the team keep its star player next season? That is the big question now.
Can the vaccine stop the new strain? That's the sixty-four-thousand-dollar question.
Will prices fall before summer? That's the million-dollar question for buyers.
Who will replace the retiring director? That remains the big question at the museum.
Can the old bridge survive another flood? That's the key question engineers face.
Will the merger be approved? That's the trillion-dollar question on Wall Street.
Can the coach fix the defense in time? That's the real question for fans.
